approvers: My wife, my tax adviser and lawyer, and the house bank
reason: A Belize shell with no track record and no committed funding wants my life's work. I will not give my time to a buyer who cannot show the money exists.
objection: Belize, no track record, no committed funding. I do not know who is really behind this, and 30% paid over three years is a risk I carry for a buyer who may not exist in three years.
instead: Keep running the business, list it anonymously on nexxt-change, and talk to buyers with known names, a German entity and a bank letter, or a family or employee succession.
would_change_my_mind: A German or EU entity with named owners, funds already committed and confirmed by a bank letter, references from earlier acquisitions, and the staff guarantee in writing.
